meta.title: Next Education – International Summer & Winter Camps in Hoi An – Da Nang, Vietnam
meta.description: Next Education organizes international summer and winter camps in Hoi An – Da Nang, Vietnam for students worldwide: English with native teachers, culture, leadership and real-world learning.

home.title: Summer & winter camps in Hoi An – Da Nang
home.lead: Change starts here. We bring international students to Vietnam’s heritage coast for camps that blend English, culture, leadership and adventure.
home.aboutTitle: A trusted partner for educational travel and camps
home.aboutText: For a decade, Next Education has designed and run educational travel programs, summer camps, winter camps and short-term camps for schools and organizations in Vietnam and around the world. We deliver authentic experiences, top-tier service and a dedicated attitude — accompanying schools on their journey to integrate with global education.
home.programsTitle: Camps in Hoi An – Da Nang
home.programsText: Two flagship camps, each fully customizable for your school or group.
home.whyTitle: Built for schools, loved by students
home.destText: A UNESCO World Heritage ancient town next to one of Asia’s most liveable beach cities. Safe, welcoming, full of culture, nature and great food — the perfect classroom without walls.
dest: Hoi An Ancient Town – UNESCO World Heritage Site
Beaches, rivers, rice fields and coconut forests
Ba Na Hills, Golden Bridge & VinWonders
International airport with direct flights across Asia
home.ctaText: Tell us about your group — age, size, dates and goals — and we’ll design a program for you.

about.title: About Next Education
about.story1: Next Education is proud to be a trusted partner in consulting and organizing educational travel programs, summer camps, winter camps and short-term camps for educational organizations in Vietnam and around the world.
about.story2: With a decade of experience, we continuously strive to become a leading provider of professional, transformative and reputable camp programs. We are committed to authentic experiences, top-tier services and a dedicated service attitude, ensuring the highest level of satisfaction.
about.story3: Our mission is to create an all-round development environment for children — where they build character, develop skills and fall in love with learning languages; where they don’t just learn and play, but are inspired on their way to becoming global citizens.
about.networkText: Besides our camps in Vietnam, we organize programs across the region and beyond.

programs.title: Our programs
programs.lead: International summer and winter camps in Hoi An – Da Nang, plus fully customized programs for schools, teachers, teams and families.
programs.customText: Every school has its own goals. We design camps and educational tours around your students — from 3-day trips to multi-week camps, for groups of 15 to 600 students.

program.datesNote: Dates are updated each season. Contact us for the next intake and pricing.
